'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Winter of 2024–25 in the Gaza Strip]], [[Gaza Strip evacuations]]
***The [[Gaza Strip]] Government Media Office reports that 110,000 out of 135,000 tents used as [[shelter]]s by [[Gaza Strip evacuations|displaced]] [[Palestinians]] have "completely deteriorated" and are now unusable due to strong winter winds and heavy rainfall. *[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Western Syria clashes (December 2024–present)|Western Syria clashes]]
***[[Syria]]'s [[Government of Syria|new government]] announces "a large-scale sweep operation" in [[Latakia]] to arrest or eliminate all remaining [[Ba'athist Syria|pro-Assad]] [[Insurgency|insurgents]] and any threats to [[national security]]. *[[2024 Afghanistan–Pakistan skirmishes]]
**[[Afghanistan]]'s [[Ministry of Defense (Afghanistan)|Ministry of Defense]] announces that they targeted several locations in [[Pakistan]] in retaliation for [[Pakistan Air Force|Pakistani aircraft]] conducting aerial bombardments within Afghanistan. '''Business and economy'''
*[[Homelessness in the United States]]
**[[Homelessness in the United States by state|U.S. homelessness]] hits a record high in 2024, increasing by more than 18% in the past year, primarily due to [[Housing in the United States|high housing costs]], [[List of natural disasters in the United States|natural disasters]], and [[urbanization|an increase in migration to major cities]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2vwdw7zn2o (BBC News)]
*[[Moldova-Russia relations]]
**Russian company [[Gazprom]] announces the supply of gas to Moldova will cease on January 1, 2025, alleging fails to fulfill its payment obligations. The [[Prime Minister of Moldova|Moldovan Prime Minister]], [[Dorin Recean]], accuses the Russian Government of deliberately weaponising energy flows to destabilise the country. [https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/28/russias-gazprom-says-it-will-stop-supplying-moldova-with-gas-next-week (Euronews)].

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Juscelino Kubitschek de Oliveira Bridge collapse]]
**The death toll from the highway collapse between [[Maranhão]] and [[Tocantins]], [[Brazil]], six days ago, increases to eleven, with six others still missing. [https://www.correiobraziliense.com.br/brasil/2024/12/amp/7021803-sobe-para-11-o-numero-de-mortos-em-ponte-que-desabou.html (''Correio Braziliense'')]
*[[Tornado outbreak of December 26–29, 2024]]
**At least two people are killed in a tornado outbreak across the [[southern United States|southern]] [[United States]], with damage reported near [[Houston]], [[Texas]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/weather/2024/12/28/tornadoes-texas-videos/77292449007/ (''USA Today'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Lukoil oil transit dispute]], [[Ukrainian energy crisis]], [[Slovakia–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Slovakia]] threatens reciprocal measures against [[Ukraine]]'s plans to suspend the transit of [[Petroleum industry in Russia|Russian oil]] to Slovakia on January 1, including suspending [[Electricity market|electricity supplies]]. In response, [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] accuses Slovakia of opening a "second energy front" against [[Government of Ukraine|Kyiv]] under [[Government of Russia|Moscow]]'s orders.  [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/28/zelenskyy-accuses-slovakia-of-opening-second-energy-front-against-ukraine (Al Jazeera)]

***At least 13,000 [[Demographics of Mozambique|Mozambicans]] flee [[Mozambique|the country]] into [[Malawi]] amid widespread [[civil unrest]] due to the results of the recent general election. [https://www.dw.com/en/mozambique-thousands-flee-to-malawi-amid-election-unrest/a-71177712 (DW)]
